_doc: Claude Code 项目级配置。PostToolUse hook 让 Agent 每次写完文件后立刻拿到 lint/arch 反馈，反馈延迟从'提交后'缩短到'编辑后'。
_doc_design: 三层反馈：编辑时(本文件) → 提交时(.husky) → CI兜底(pnpm verify)

hooks.command: FILE_PATH=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"(file_path|path)"\s*:\s*"[^"]+"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*:\s*"([^"]+)"/\1/'); if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '^(.*/)?(web/(src|server)|web/server\.js).*\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$'; then echo "[harness] lint $FILE_PATH"; (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && node scripts/lint-file.mjs "$FILE_PATH") || true; fi

FILE_PATH=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"(file_path|path)"\s*:\s*"[^"]+"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*:\s*"([^"]+)"/\1/'); if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '^(.*/)?(web/server/routes/|web/src/(components|pages|store)/)'; then (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && node scripts/arch-check.mjs) || true; fi
